Moser分享了诺贝尔奖。在神经学中,grid cell 位于视觉信息跟记忆海马体的接口位置。如果把记忆海马体,想像成硬盘,眼睛想当于摄像头,grid cell大致相当于内存。

I investigated the reproductive strategies of the green hydra and the relationship between asexual budding and sexual reproduction.
